reviews.author: Christina R…
reviews.body: Jenn is INCREDIBLE. For years I've gone to chiropractors and massage therapists, and she is the ONLY one to help with my chronic pain and actually give lasting relief. She doesn't just give you some cookie cutter, short-cut massage like some places, she actually targets the muscles that are locking up and gets to the source of your pain and issues. Every time I leave, I feel like I'm practically floating because all of my aches, pain, and tension are gone! Thank you for being amazing!
